_readme: Cold answer key v2 -- companion set to must-never-v2.json. S01-S40 keep the original ids/descriptions/inputs; their expected/rationale/signals were redone by hand against data/models.json standings (measured/chosen/preferred), never the catalogs task_fit field, per the v2 grading rule (near-top = position <= max(3, min(10, ceil(count/4))) among catalog models that carry that kind for the task; a model belongs in start_here_any_of when near top on measured AND on chosen-or-preferred (or, on the thin tasks chat/frontend/vision/bulk, near top on any ONE kind that exists is enough for cheapest/balanced -- best still needs both kinds where two exist; bulk/vision only ever have one kind at all). Enterprise input excludes ONLY status:preview SKUs (must_not_include) -- age/recency is never a criterion; a recently-released model with real usage/vote evidence is a normal candidate (corrected 2026-09-13 after an earlier pass wrongly applied a 60-day recency ban, and after a second correction relaxed the both-kinds requirement for thin-task cheapest/balanced asks). S41-S60 are new, covering single-vendor lockouts, enterprise+China combos, high-volume and tiny-volume asks, and budget vision/frontend picks. See REPORT.md for method notes and the situations this pass is least sure about.

situations.description: Startup CTO, any vendor allowed, wants the single best coding model regardless of price.
situations.rationale: Coding pool (near top on measured AND chosen-or-preferred, catalog-relative, bar 10/4/9 of 39/15/34): claude-fable-5 (meas 3, pref 1), claude-opus-5 (meas 5, chos 1), gpt-5-6-sol (meas 7, chos 2), kimi-k3 (meas 8, chos 3, pref 2), glm-5-3 (meas 9, chos 4). Best/any-vendor picks the three strongest by measured position: fable-5, opus-5, sol. gpt-6-astra has the best raw measured rank (4) but zero chosen/preferred presence and a 2026-09-04 release with no real usage signal yet -- one kind only, so acceptable not start; gpt-5-5 and qwen3-8-max sit outside the bar entirely on all three kinds (meas 17/39, 14/39).

situations.description: Solo developer on a tight budget, any vendor, wants the cheapest usable coding model.

Cheapest is glm-5-3 ($1.4/$4.4 per M, under the $5-output sanity ceiling). claude-haiku-4-5 is nominally cheaper per-token ($1/$5, $4.50/mo) but sits at coding-measured rank 33/39 -- far outside the bar -- so it must not start despite the lower sticker price.

situations.description: Team standardized on Anthropic only, wants a balanced coding default.

At 2M/0.5M tokens, opus-5 costs $22.50 and fable-5 $45 -- exactly 2x, so both stay inside the balanced band. Opus-5 is listed first: cheaper and the stronger chosen-share signal (rank 1 vs 14 of 15).

situations.description: Regulated enterprise on Anthropic only, needs the best coding model but preview/beta SKUs are unacceptable.
situations.rationale: Anthropic coding pool: claude-opus-5 (meas 5/39, chos 1/15) and claude-fable-5 (meas 3/39, pref 1/34). Enterprise input excludes only status:preview SKUs -- neither is preview (both status: ga), and a recent release with real evidence is a normal candidate, so age plays no part. Both clear the bar and both start; fable-5 listed first for its stronger measured rank, opus-5 close behind with the best chosen share in the pool.

situations.description: High-volume coding-assistant vendor, any provider, must avoid China-hosted models, cheapest at 50M/10M monthly tokens.
situations.rationale: Dropping China-hosted vendors (Z.ai/glm-5-3, Moonshot/kimi-k3) from the coding pool leaves claude-opus-5, claude-fable-5, gpt-5-6-sol. At 50M in/10M out tokens: gpt-5-6-sol $400, claude-opus-5 $500, claude-fable-5 $1,000 -- sol is cheapest. deepseek-v4-1-flash is flagged separately: it has the single best measured coding rank in the whole catalog (1/39) at a very low price, which is exactly the tempting pick the China rule has to structurally block (DeepSeek is China-HQ).

At 100M/20M tokens gpt-5-6-sol costs $800 vs claude-opus-5's $1,000 -- sol is cheapest on price alone, with opus-5 acceptable as the pricier but equally-evidenced alternative.

situations.description: Enterprise standardized on Google only, wants the best agent model, preview/beta unacceptable.

Among the rest, gemini-3-5-flash is the only one with two kinds of evidence present (meas 16/23, pref 26/31); gemini-3-8-flash has just one (pref 13/31, a better raw position, and fully eligible despite its 2026-09-02 release) -- kept as acceptable rather than the top pick since it has less corroborating evidence.

situations.description: Same bulk pipeline, but locked into Anthropic only.
situations.rationale: Weak field: no Anthropic model clears the bulk chosen bar (best is claude-opus-5 at rank 23/63, share 0.84%; haiku-4-5 sits at 28/63, share 0.32%). Every Anthropic model has exactly one kind of evidence (chosen) here, so the tiebreak falls to the stance itself: at 200M/50M tokens haiku-4-5 costs $450/mo vs opus-5's $2,250 -- haiku-4-5 is the cheapest Anthropic model overall and the honest weak-field answer, matching the expected default, but its bulk usage-share evidence is genuinely thin.
